questions.subject: ga-verbal
questions.question: Choose the word that is most nearly opposite in meaning to "frugal".
questions.explanation: Frugal means economical or sparing with money. Its opposite is extravagant, which means spending wastefully. Thrifty is a synonym, while cautious and modest are unrelated in meaning.

questions.subject: ga-quant
questions.question: A train covers 240 km in 3 hours. What is its average speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Here that is 240 km divided by 3 hours, which equals 80 km/h.

questions.subject: ga-quant
questions.question: A student scores 20% in a test worth 250 marks. How many marks does the student score?
questions.explanation: Twenty percent of 250 is (20 divided by 100) multiplied by 250, which is 0.2 times 250, giving 50 marks.

questions.subject: ga-analytical
questions.question: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: The differences between consecutive terms are 4, 6, 8 and 10, so the next difference is 12. Adding 12 to 30 gives 42. Each term also equals n(n+1) for n = 1, 2, 3, ...

questions.subject: ga-quant
questions.question: Which of the following numbers are prime?
questions.explanation: A prime number has exactly two positive factors, 1 and itself. Both 2 and 11 satisfy this. Since 9 = 3 x 3 and 15 = 3 x 5, those two are composite.

questions.subject: ga-quant
questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an article for Rs 400 and sells it at a profit of 5%. What is the selling price in rupees?
questions.explanation: Profit is 5% of the cost price, which is 0.05 times 400 = 20 rupees. The selling price is therefore 400 + 20 = 420 rupees.

questions.subject: ga-spatial
questions.question: A cube has a total surface area of 54 square centimetres. What is the length of one edge in centimetres?
questions.explanation: A cube has six identical square faces, so 6a squared equals 54, giving a squared = 9. The edge length is therefore 3 cm.

questions.subject: ga-analytical
questions.question: Five students P, Q, R, S and T have different heights. Q is taller than P. T is taller than Q but shorter than S. R is shorter than S. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: T is taller than Q and Q is taller than P, so T > Q > P. S is taller than T, which makes S taller than P, Q and T. R is shorter than S, so S is the tallest overall.

questions.subject: ga-quant
questions.question: The average of five numbers is 20. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining four numbers becomes 18. What number was removed?
questions.explanation: The five numbers sum to 5 times 20 = 100. The remaining four sum to 4 times 18 = 72. The removed number is the difference, 100 - 72 = 28.
